name: ROOM 0
desc: UNUSED

name: REC CENTER
desc: YOU ARE IN THE FORMER RECREATION. CENTER. EQUIPMENT FOR MUSCLE-TRAINING IN ZERO GRAVITY LITTERS THE AREA.

name: REPAIR HOLD
desc: THIS WAS THE REPAIR AND MAINTENANCE HOLD OF THE SHIP. YOU CAN ONLY LEAVE IT VIA THE GIANT HANGAR DOOR TO THE WEST.

name: WRECKED HOLD
desc: YOU ARE IN THE WRECKED HOLD OF A SPACE SHIP. THE CAVERNOUS INTERIOR IS LITTERED WITH FLOATING WRECKAGE, AS IF FROM SOME TERRIBLE EXPLOSION EONS AGO......

name: OBSERVATORY
desc: THE VIEW OF THE STARS FROM THIS OBSERVATION PLATFORM IS MAGNIFICENT, AS FAR AS THE EYE CAN SEE. THE SINGLE EXIT IS BACK WHERE YOU CAME FROM.

name: HYDRO FARM
desc: ACRE UPON ACRE OF DRIED-UP HYDROPONIC PLANT BEDS STRETCH AROUND YOU. ONCE THIS AREA FED THE THOUSAND ON BOARD THE SHIP.

name: ESCAPE
desc: YOU ARE FREE. YOU HAVE MADE IT. YOUR POD SAILS FREE INTO SPACE...........

name: CREW QUARTERS
desc: YOU ARE IN THE CREW'S SLEEPING QUARTERS.

name: PASSENGER QUARTERS
desc: THE FORMER PASSENGER SUSPENDED ANIMATION DORMITORY...

name: HOSPITAL
desc: THIS IS THE SHIP'S HOSPITAL, WHITE AND STERILE. A BUZZING SOUND, AND A STRANGE WARMTH COME FROM THE SOUTH, WHILE A CHILL IS FELT TO THE NORTH.

name: GALLEY
desc: FOOD FOR ALL THE CREW WAS PREPARED IN THIS GALLEY. THE REMAINS FROM PREPARATIONS OF THE FINAL MEAL CAN BE SEEN. DOORS LEAVE THE GALLEY TO THE SOUTH AND TO THE WEST.

name: ESCAPE POD
desc: AHA • • • THAT LOOKS LIKE THE SPACE POD NOW, AND ITS OUTSIDE DIALS INDICATE IT IS STILL IN PERFECT CONDITION.

name: NAV ROOM
desc: STRANGE MACHINERY LINES THE WALLS, WHILE OVERHEAD, A HOLOGRAPHIC STAR MAP SLOWLY TURNS. THE FLICKERING GREEN LIGHT MAKES IT HARD TO SEE.

name: RADIATION
desc: YOU ARE CAUGHT IN A DEADLY RADIATION FIELD. SLOWLY YOU REALISE THIS IS THE END.

name: ENGINE ROOM
desc: THIS IS THE POWER CENTER OF THE SHIP. THE CHARACTERISTIC BLUE METAL LIGHT OF THE STILL-FUNCTIONING ION DRIVE FILLS THE ENGINE ROOM. THE HAZE MAKES IT DIFFICULT TO SEE.

name: ANDROID ROOM
desc: YOU ARE STANDING IN THE ANDROID STORAGE HOLD. ROW UPON ROW OF METAL MEN STAND STIFFLY AT ATTENTION, AWAITING THE DISTINCTIVE SOUND OF THEIR LONG-DEAD CAPTAIN TO SET THEM INTO MOTION. A LIGHT COMES FROM THE WEST AND THROUGH THE GRAVITY WELL SET INTO THE FLOOR.

name: TRADE HALL
desc: ANOTHER CAVERNOUS, SEEMINGLY ENDLESS HOLD, THIS ONE CRAMMED WITH GOODS FOR TRADING...

name: ARMORY
desc: A STARK, METALLIC ROOM, REEKING OF LUBRICANTS. WEAPONS LINE THE WALL, RANK UPON RANK. EXITS FOR SOLDIER ANDROIDS ARE TO THE NORTH AND THE EAST.

name: REPAIR HOLD
desc: ABOVE YOU IS THE GRAVITY SHAFT LEADING TO THE ENGINE ROOM. THIS IS THE SHIP REPAIR CENTER WITH EMERGENCY EXITS TO THE SOLDIER ANDROIDS STORAGE AND TO THE TRADING GOODS HOLD.

name: COMMAND CENTER
desc: YOU'VE STUMBLED ON THE SECRET COMMAND CENTER WHERE SCREENS BRING VIEWS FROM ALL AROUND THE SHIP. THERE ARE TWO EXITS........

name: DEAD END
desc: YOU HAVE RUN OUT OF OXYGEN...
